infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Travora uses your location to show your position on the live trip map and help your travel group stay connected.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Travora needs camera access so you can take a profile photo.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Travora needs access to your photo library so you can choose a profile picture.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Travora saves trip photos to your library.
infoPlist.NSUserNotificationsUsageDescription: Travora sends trip reminders and travel updates. You can turn these off anytime in your profile.
